_readme: Rulings (and, under "rules", rules entries) that are no longer current but are kept for reference. Key = ruling id (from its link, #/ruling/<id>). asOf: the document version from which it no longer applies (shown as 'No longer current as of …'). reason (optional): one short sentence. replacedBy (optional): id of the ruling or rule that replaces it. stagingTest: true shows the entry ONLY on staging.xwingarchives.com — use it for trying things out; never on a real deprecation.

rr-50.reason: TEST ENTRY for the staging site only. This ruling has not actually changed.

ep-115.reason: Huge ships now receive a deplete token instead of a jam token, so no token is removed.

appendix-huge-ships.reason: The Official XWA Epic Rules now cover huge ships, replacing this appendix.

attacks.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules. The new text no longer mentions using reinforce tokens at range 4–5.

huge-damage-cards.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules. It adds a rule for damage cards on Standard Loadout ships.

docking-with-huge-ships.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

energy.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

engagement-value.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules. The new text drops the line saying a huge ship's initiative can't be altered.

huge-ion.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules. It spells out what an ionized huge ship can do.

movement.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules. It adds a Movement Grace Period for rounds 1 and 2.

move-and-rotate-effects.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

overlapping-objects.reason: Changed: obstacles now deal 2 damage (asteroids, debris) or break locks and give 2 deplete tokens (gas clouds); an overlapped non-huge ship suffers 1 damage and is placed by section at range 0, with no dice rolled.

obstruction-by-huge-ships.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules. It adds that a friendly attacker's attack is still obstructed.

precision-shot.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

red-maneuvers.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

resource-trackers.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

huge-setup.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules. It adds that a huge ship can't overlap obstacles while deploying.

huge-stress.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

huge-tractor.reason: Changed: a tractored huge ship now also has its agility reduced by 1.

turret-arc-indicators.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

example-of-overlapping-a-standard-ship.reason: This example shows the old overlap rules (full rear arc, dice rolled for stress and damage).

epic-allied.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

epic-command-upgrades.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

epic-restore.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

epic-wings.reason: Changed: wing positions now follow the ships' ID numbers (lowest is the wing leader), and wingmates no longer split off.

epic-wing-leader.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

epic-wingmates.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

epic-wing-id-card.reason: Wing positions now follow the ships' ID numbers.

epic-splitting-from-a-wing.reason: Changed: wingmates can't split from their wing; effects that would split them are replaced (see Forced Splitting).

epic-joining-a-wing.reason: Replaced by the Official XWA Epic Rules.

epic-wing-overlap-diagrams.reason: Changed: a wingmate that can't be placed in formation now goes into reserve instead of executing the maneuver on its own.
